specification.objective: Ensure Magi stored-memory compaction never accepts a preview or apply payload that violates its actual reduction and entry-count postconditions.

requirements.statement: For memory and user targets reject HTTP compact-apply payloads whose character count exceeds 60% of source, does not shrink source, or whose entry count exceeds source-derived cap.
Keep whole-store stale fingerprint and native locked batch semantics; rejection must not mutate stored memory.
Compaction previews on tiny sources must not report success for an unchanged-length proposed replacement.
Accept valid proposals at exactly the hard character limit; preserve preview-model and existing Hermes plugin contracts.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Parameterized endpoint regression tests fail on baseline for over-budget, over-entry-count and non-reducing proposals, and pass after correction for both targets.
Tiny-source equal-length preview regression fails on baseline and passes on corrected source.
Boundary-case 60% proposals apply successfully; full existing tests, coverage and Hermes native plugin validation pass.

invariants.statement: Never write MEMORY.md or USER.md directly; native Hermes MemoryStore owns durable commits.
Preserve configured LLM model routing and explicit preview-first apply approval.
No mutation is permitted after stale fingerprint or validation failures.

forbidden_states.statement: A successful apply can store entries larger than 60% of live source characters or exceed count cap.
A preview with no reduction can be accepted on tiny inputs.

inputs.statement: Existing stored memory and user entries with Hermes-owned entry delimiter.

outputs.statement: Valid compacted entries applied atomically or HTTP 400/409 without a memory mutation.

failure_semantics.statement: Invalid compaction proposal rejects the request; concurrent updates cause a conflict and do not change stored memory.
